governed.config: kubeconform runs with its own defaults and the schemas of the Kubernetes version it knows; the project has no configuration file for it, so nothing the project holds changes its rules

suppressions.description: not honored: kubeconform has no in-code suppression

en.label: kubeconform (Kubernetes manifests)
en.purpose: Validates Kubernetes manifests (YAML and JSON) against the official JSON schema of each resource kind and API version: unknown fields, wrong types, missing required fields.
en.limitation: It checks the shape of a resource, not whether it is a good idea, and it skips resource kinds it has no schema for (custom resources) instead of failing.
en.needs: The network: it downloads the schema of each resource kind and version when it runs. No project dependencies.

pt-BR.label: kubeconform (manifestos Kubernetes)
pt-BR.purpose: Valida manifestos Kubernetes (YAML e JSON) contra o JSON schema oficial de cada tipo de recurso e versão de API: campos desconhecidos, tipos errados, campos obrigatórios ausentes.
pt-BR.limitation: Verifica a forma de um recurso, não se ele é uma boa ideia, e ignora os tipos de recurso sem schema (recursos customizados) em vez de falhar.
pt-BR.needs: A rede: ele baixa o schema de cada tipo de recurso e versão quando roda. Sem dependências do projeto.
